purpose: One governed, offline, one-laptop faculty demonstration of the already-complete product: launcher, isolated workspace, preflight, runbook, one coherent real-browser journey, reproducibility and restart evidence - with zero scientific, runtime, FL, API or frontend change. Not CAP-011 (clean-machine release).

frontend.command: npm run preview (after npm run build)

preflight: scripts/capstone_demo_preflight.py (identities/artifacts only; no installs; no science)

readiness_probes.product: GET /product/v1/system exact identity incl. CAPSTONE_PRODUCT_API_V1_3, MODEL_V2_FINAL, DEMO, ENABLED_ENGINEERING, SIMULATED_ONLY

restart: stop the stack with Ctrl+C, RESUME the same workspace, reload the product in the browser, compare every API payload and the semantic digest; no monitoring or FL rerun
offline_network_policy: browser requests intercepted: only 127.0.0.1/localhost continue, everything else is failed and recorded; Clerk never initialised in DEMO; the claim is limited to the NHM demo processes and browser journey
failure_handling: runbook sections 7 (service/port/monitoring/federation failures: keep failed evidence, create new sessions/runs, never fake completion)

claim_boundary.allowed: The NHM capstone product is ready for an offline one-laptop faculty demonstration using simulated device input, released research monitoring, genuine engineering federation, persistent history, and frozen research-evidence views.

preserved_disclosures: CAP-008 amendment 85fe0b3 included unrelated result evidence
CAP-007 one-active-run is not a distributed lock
candidate sandbox has no inference runtime
out_of_scope: CAP-011 / clean-machine release / installer / archive / release manifest
training on user monitoring data / personal models
chronology_disclosure: The launcher, workspace, preflight, runbook, tests and the canonical runner/driver were written and unit-tested before the freeze commit. Before the freeze the real launcher was started and stopped by hand once (default ports, prewarm), and the coverage harness plus one full journey with restart were dry-run end to end into a scratch directory outside the repository to find defects (a fake-service test helper defect, a wrong argv slice in a test, and a missing federation-page locality capture were fixed). None of that output is committed; all recorded results come after the freeze commit.
